📖 HOW TO PLAY

Movement & Shooting

WASD / Arrow Keys: Move around the dungeon. Your character automatically shoots the nearest enemy.

Elements

  • 1 — Fire: spinning fire, meteor rain, dragon.
  • 2 — Ice: freezing attack, snowmen, avalanche.
  • 3 — Lightning: volts, taser orb, electric clones.

Skills

F / G / H: Use Skill 1, Skill 2, and Skill 3. Skills unlock as you level up and each has its own cooldown.

Level Up

Defeat monsters to gain XP. Leveling increases your power and unlocks stronger elemental skills.

Bosses

Defeat normal bosses to progress. Every 10 boss kills triggers a 10-second warning before a Special Boss appears. The Special Boss summons gray minions and red mini-bosses while it is alive.

Disasters

After defeating your first Special Boss, random disasters can arrive in combinations of one, two, or three. Each disaster wave lasts 30 seconds and returns on a 2-minute cycle. Watch for the warning banner and sound. Tornadoes, lightning strikes, asteroids, blizzards, and lava effects are now displayed at 5× size. Tornadoes and lightning deal 50 damage; asteroids deal 50 damage and burn for 2 damage every 5 seconds for 20 seconds; blizzards slow everyone and chill the player for 5 damage, while Fire skills clear the chill for 20 seconds; glowing lava tiles deal 20 damage for 5 seconds.

Survive

If your HP reaches zero, your character falls, the attempt is marked as FAILED ATTEMPT, and you can restart from the beginning or return to the main menu.

GAME PAUSED

Your gameplay is paused. Continue when you are ready, or exit to the main menu. Your progress will be saved automatically.

YOU DIE

FAILED ATTEMPT — choose what to do next.

Press R to try again or M for main menu.
MOVE WASD / ARROWS   ELEMENT 1 FIRE 2 ICE 3 LIGHTNING   SKILL 1 F   SKILL 2 G   SKILL 3 H   RESTART R
